sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Glory to CPSU is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Greetings, soldier! I've got an urgent job for you. Back before all this, I had an old friend, name was Oleg. We lost touch somewhere along the way, though I know he stayed in Tarkov. Then the other night... I had a bad feeling. Call it a dream, call it a gut instinct. I need you to look for him downtown. Check his apartment and the place where he worked. I can't remember the exact addresses anymore, but you should be able to figure it out. Just look for anything with a Soviet touch. Oleg was a true patriot."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the place of work of Prapor's friend on Streets of Tarkov
  - (Optional) Locate the apartment of Prapor's friend on Streets of Tarkov
- Obtain any information on the fate of Prapor's friend
- Hand over the found data

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Nothing at all? Not even a body, just this old book? Alright, I'll keep searching."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:

In this quest you have to find Prapor's friend's journal in the museum on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns in a room on the second floor.

sections.heading: Second spawn
sections.text: Behind the teddy bear on the chair.

sections.heading: Third spawn
sections.text: On the left in the bottom compartment of the glass cabinet.

sections.heading: Fourth spawn
sections.text: In the bottom compartment of the bookshelf, on top of books.
